# Miles Fitzgerald

> Design Director at Microsoft working on AI agents in Excel. Previously Spotify, Condé Nast and Adobe. Angel investor in AI-native productivity tools, speaker and writer.

Fifteen years crafting software for everyone from the Fortune 500 to folks on the subway. Still gets a kick out of spotting the work in the wild.

## Work

- **Now** — Excel: Design Director, exploring what AI means for a billion+ people and their spreadsheets
- **2017** — Microsoft: led design for Outlook Mobile on iOS and Android, 100M to 300M+ weekly actives
- **2015** — Founding member: a venture-backed zero-to-one, $1M raised from Chamath Palihapitiya, grew to 100K+ users
- **2014** — Spotify: helped with mobile and bringing in the black/green era
- **2011** — A scrappy startup: small team, users across the table, shipping constantly

## Investments & advisory

Writes pre-seed and seed cheques into AI-native productivity tools, then sticks around to help entrepreneurs build great businesses.

- [Biscuit](https://www.biscuit.so/): invested
- [Pretty Data](https://www.prettydata.co/): invested

## Things I make

- [BlixtSnap](https://milesfitzgerald.github.io/BlixtSnap/#install): a Mac app for screenshots
- [Essential Mix](https://milesfitzgerald.github.io/essential-mix/): a SoundCloud mixtape for makers looking to flow
- [NYC subway app](https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/01/nyregion/clocking-your-train.html): an iOS app for the MTA, featured in The New York Times
